hooks.text: Commuters stepped into mild spring weather hours before a blinding whiteout.
Up to fifty foot snowdrifts paralyzed New York City in 1888.
Why did a spring morning suddenly bury New York in snow?

title: Why Did a Mild Spring Morning Bring a Fatal Blizzard? ❄️
description: Commuters stepped into unseasonably mild spring weather just hours before a sudden whiteout blizzard froze New York City in its tracks in March 1888.
